title: Parse an order blotter
hints: `#include <string>` and read the side with `std::string side; std::cin >> side;`, then compare with `side == "BUY"`.
Read the three fields of an order, then check the stream **before** using them: `if (!(std::cin >> qty >> price))`.
Distinguish "no more orders" from "bad order": try to read the side first. If that fails, the input is simply over.
